The bug is that the `exclude` parameter is being passed to the `handler` function with an index of `-1`. This is causing a `ValueError: Negative indices cannot be used to exclude items on unsized iterables`. The `exclude` parameter is a set of field names or indices to exclude from serialization. In this case, the `exclude` set contains the integer `-1`, which is causing the error.

To fix this bug, the `handler` function should be modified to handle negative indices gracefully. One possible solution is to ignore any negative indices and continue processing the remaining items. Another solution is to raise a custom error message indicating that negative indices are not allowed.
